title: Variance and standard deviation
goal: I can calculate and interpret the variance and standard deviation.
teach: The variance is the mean of the squared distances from the mean: σ² = Σ(x − x̄)² ÷ n. The standard deviation is its square root, σ = √(σ²). A bigger σ means the data is more spread out. Your calculator’s statistics mode gives σ directly.
watch:
Take the square root of the variance at the end.

Problem-solving lens
Estimate first: is the typical distance from the mean small or large? Your σ should match that guess.

qs.steps:
1. Formulas (spread): variance σ² = Σ(x − x̄)² ÷ n; standard deviation σ = √variance.
2. Mean = 50 ÷ 5 = 10: Σ(x − 10)² = 16 + 4 + 0 + 4 + 16 = 40
3. σ² = 40 ÷ 5 = 8; σ = √8 = 2,83
